one_line: The paper develops and simulates an energy-per-part indicator, energy profit bottleneck, and opportunity-window scheduling for a discrete-part serial production line (parts/machines/buffers, automotive-style); the term 'continuous flow model' refers to a mathematical modeling abstraction, not continuous-flow industrial production.
